examples.en: Tang Fang of the Tang clan requests an audience with Master Yu. I carry a keepsake of an old friend of yours—I beg you to open your mouth but one word.
examples.zh: 唐门唐方，求见玉门主。我这儿有玉先生故友之物，请求先生开一字尊口。

examples.en: If word of Father's injury ever leaks out, there will be no road left for us but death.
examples.zh: 倘若爹爹受伤的消息一旦泄露出去，唐方便只有死路一条。
